 Yuki Iwamura - AP 
 As featured on
 +3 
 After a 13-year wait, 'Grand Theft Auto VI' arrives with enormous hype and expectations 
 “Grand Theft Auto VI” is set to launch, bringing players back to Vice City. Rockstar Games faces the challenge of following one of the bestselling video games ever. The game becomes playable at midnight local time on Thursday for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, making New Zealand among the first places in the world to get the game. The “Grand Theft Auto” franchise has sold over 470 million units worldwide. “GTA V,” released in 2013, accounts for more than 230 million of those sales. The game features two new protagonists, Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, in a sprawling Florida-inspired world. Miami has embraced its connection to Vice City, with local promotions and events.
